dimensions.assessment: Affects Veterans Health Administration leadership, staff, commission members, and indirectly the millions of veterans receiving VA health care.
dimensions.evidence: There is established the Veterans Health Administration Policy Advisory Commission... composed of 17 members appointed by the Comptroller General

dimensions.assessment: Creates an oversight and advisory body focused on reviewing operations, evaluating health systems, and submitting policy recommendations.
dimensions.evidence: review operations at the Veterans Health Administration; and prepare reports for Congress based on such review, including recommendations to Congress.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations for commission operations, member compensation at executive schedule rates, staff pay, contracts, and grants, separate from the Comptroller General's budget.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall submit requests for appropriations in the same manner as the Comptroller General... but amounts appropriated for the Commission shall be separate

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code to permanently establish a new federal advisory commission with broad investigatory and data-collection powers.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 1 of title 38, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new section: Sec. 120. Veterans Health Administration Policy Advisory Commission

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent advisory commission with staggered 5-year member terms and recurring annual reporting mandates.
dimensions.evidence: A member of the Commission shall be appointed under subsection (b)(1) for a term of 5 years... By not later than March 15 of each year, the Commission shall submit to Congress a report

importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a 17-member advisory commission to review Veterans Health Administration operations, conduct studies, and report annual recommendations to Congress.
